aiclient.prompt:
Please add Deskway as an MCP tool, so you can control the computers I allow.
Server: {server}
Account: {user}

1. Find out your computer's system and architecture, and download the matching file:
{files}
   Save it in the user folder: on Windows {windows}, on macOS and Linux {unix} (then chmod +x).
   Compute its SHA-256. If it differs from the one above, stop and tell me.
2. Run: deskway login --server {server} --user {user} --name "<your name, e.g. Claude Code>"
   It shows 6 digits. Tell me the digits and wait while I approve in my browser. Never ask me for a password.
3. Add it as an MCP server, with its full path:
   - Claude Code: claude mcp add deskway -- <full path> mcp
   - Other clients: add {"command": "<full path>", "args": ["mcp"]} to the MCP config
4. Call computers and tell me which computers you see and which allow AI control.
If any step fails, tell me the error as it is; do not work around it.

guide.title: Trust the Deskway certificate
guide.ios.install: Open Settings, tap Profile Downloaded, and review the profile details. The profile must contain exactly one item, the certificate “{name}”. If it does, tap Install. Otherwise, cancel.
guide.ios.trust: In Settings › General › About › Certificate Trust Settings, turn on full trust for the Deskway certificate.
guide.android.install: Open Settings and search for “Install a certificate”. Choose CA certificate and select the downloaded file.
guide.other.install: Open the downloaded file and install it as a trusted root certificate. On macOS, use Keychain Access to set it to Always Trust.
guide.fingerprint: Compare this SHA-256 fingerprint with the one shown on the hub computer. Check that the downloaded certificate has the same fingerprint before installing it.
